title: pureTV Manager 0.5.0 · 论坛正文与跟帖 / 旧版检查更新
description: Official unmodified macOS Manager clients, captured as genuine timestamped native PNG sequences. The 0.5.0 forum chapter precedes a separate 0.4.19-to-0.5.0 update-check chapter. Source sampling intervals are preserved inside retained ranges; 30 fps is an export rate using repeated existing screenshots, not a claim of native recording frame rate or application performance.

chapters.sourceTimeBasis: Seconds from the first capture-request timestamp. Cuts begin at an available native screenshot; intervals between retained screenshots are preserved, then existing frames are repeated for the 30-fps export.
chapters.cutAlignmentNote: Requested bounds are listed. Each cut begins at its first available native screenshot; the original intervals between included screenshots are preserved. The last included screenshot is held until that edit range reaches its declared duration. No UI or pointer interpolation is used.

The later automation wait timed out because OCR missed the cursor-covered refresh button, although native refreshed content remained valid. No refresh success or return-to-list is claimed in the edit.

packageStoreMatch.meaning: The official 0.5.0 package used for forum footage matches the 0.5.0 store package detected by the old client.
packageStoreMatch.verificationMethod: Compared the official macOS ARM64 DMG's Git blob SHA-1 and byte count with the client entry at the fixed Gitee revision.

postProduction.editing: Only the listed original-time ranges are retained. Desktop areas outside the complete native window are cropped. The full window is placed uniformly on a branded canvas. Titles and captions are outside the UI. Brief fade-in/out transitions are applied at chapter boundaries.
postProduction.nativeBackdropBlur: The update modal blur is part of the native app, not post-production masking.
postProduction.temporalHandling: A lossless VFR intermediate preserves each PNG capture-request timestamp to millisecond container precision; the final 30-fps export holds existing frames, with no optical-flow interpolation.
postProduction.sourceEvidenceDistribution: Original native PNG sequences and capture logs are on the recording evidence branches; the release folder contains the finished video and this metadata.

audio.type: Original quiet synthesized instrumental bed composed for this video
audio.synthesis: Deterministic sine oscillators with two quiet harmonics; slow four-chord voicings, sparse plucks, and fades. No source-app audio is used.
